3. Panel labeled “SHOT 03 4.0–6.5s” with title “崩れ落ち→低い払い”. Stick figure drops into a very low sweeping pose, one leg extended, torso tilted, red curved arrow sweeping across the ground and green vertical balance arrow. Include three white note strips: “落ちるフリ”, “胸が半円に流れる”, “手で床を探る”.
4. Panel labeled “SHOT 04 6.5–9.0s” with title “ふらつき回転”. Stick figure spins unsteadily in the center with a large red circular arrow around the body and a small blue counter-arrow near the head. Include three white note strips: “上体は遅れる”, “回転矢印”, “視線だけ先行”.
5. Panel labeled “SHOT 05 9.0–12.0s” with title “酔い避け→掌底”. Stick figure leans back in an evasive drunken sway while extending one palm strike to the right; long red arrow indicates the palm movement, green arrow shows S-shaped torso flow. Include three white note strips: “S字の体軸”, “避ける→返す”, “掌底は寸止め”. Add a narrow vertical temple signboard in the right background.
6. Panel labeled “SHOT 06 12.0–15s” with title “家賃回収拳の決め”. Stick figure finishes in a comic triumphant stance, one arm raised holding a small yellow paper sign marked “札”, body upright but still tipsy; red arcs near the feet show wobbling. Include three white note strips: “止まれない決めポーズ”, “お札を見せる”, “最後にドヤ顔”.

Text and notes: Use Japanese visible text for the title, shot labels, shot subtitles, note strips, and production memos. content: Create a cinematic visual titled: “THE PEOPLE WE BECOME.” The image should depict multiple stages of one human life existing simultaneously inside a single interconnected environment shaped by memory, growth and emotional transition. Avoid the feeling of: - a motivational poster, - a staircase timeline, - or separate portraits pasted together. Instead, the world itself should evolve naturally between life phases as if memories are physically blending into one another. The composition follows a winding stone pathway moving through different emotional spaces connected seamlessly across the image. At the bottom of the frame: A newborn sleeps inside a softly lit woven cradle near a dim bedside lamp. The atmosphere feels warm, silent and untouched. Nearby: - folded baby blankets, - soft shadows, - wooden toys, - faint moonlight through curtains, - dust particles drifting in warm air. The pathway slowly transitions into early childhood. A young child runs barefoot through a living room filled with scattered crayons, comic books, paper airplanes and half-built toy structures. Late-afternoon sunlight pours through large windows and reflects softly across wooden floors. The environment gradually changes again without hard separation. The next version appears around age 13: sitting alone on a rooftop during light rainfall wearing headphones and holding a notebook. Distant city lights blur softly behind him while unfinished sketches scatter beside him. The atmosphere becomes quieter and emotionally uncertain. Further along the path: A university-age version studies late at night at a cluttered desk illuminated only by a warm desk lamp and laptop screen. Around him: - highlighted textbooks, - coffee cups, - handwritten notes, - exhaustion, - ambition, - and isolation. Rain reflects softly across the apartment window behind him. At the highest point of the composition: An older version stands quietly overlooking a sunrise city skyline from a hillside path above the city. He looks calm rather than triumphant. His clothing is simple and grounded: rolled sleeves, slightly tired posture, hands in pockets, wind moving softly through his shirt. He should visibly feel like the same person shaped by every previous version. The transitions between life stages should contain subtle symbolic continuity: - flowers growing through cracks in concrete, - notebook pages blending into city architecture, - rainwater reflections becoming skyline lights, - old drawings faintly appearing on apartment walls, - childhood objects partially hidden inside later environments. content:
Create a comical scientific explanation illustration. The verification theme is "{argument name="validation theme" default="How many banana peels are needed to make a car slip?"}"

A vertical A4 manga-style infographic that seriously verifies absurd questions with science and calculations. White background, thick black lines, and emphasis colors of red, blue, and yellow. A design reminiscent of retro educational manga, science reference books, or scientific columns. Use a professor character, surprised people, speech bubbles, hand-drawn arrows, red pen annotations, and chalkboard-style formula boxes. The overall atmosphere should be 'using physics to verify a silly question with full effort,' making it fun, energetic, and not too serious.

Structure:

1. 
Depict the theme's situation in an exaggerated and ridiculous way that is understood at a glance. The characters are trying their best, but the appearance is quite reckless. The professor interjects with a comment from the side.

2. Thinking with Real Numbers
Display 3 to 4 boxes of important values related to the theme, such as speed, time, distance, weight, force, temperature, or energy. Include comparison charts or timelines to clearly show the gap between 'human senses' and the 'scale of the phenomenon.'

3. Formula Corner
Draw necessary conditions or comparison formulas largely in chalkboard-style frames. Example: 'Required Ability > Human Limit' 'Reaction Time < Time Phenomenon Occurs' 'Required Force/Speed/Durability ≫ Normal Human.' Formulas don't need to be strictly accurate; keep them intuitive and easy to understand.

4. Is Realization Impossible?
Explain problem points using three small panels. Example: ① Too fast / Too heavy / Too hot ② Precision is too severe ③ Even if successful, the body won't hold out / Surroundings will be in trouble. Include comical failure illustrations, onomatopoeia, and speech bubbles.

5. What If It Was Realized?
Make this part important. Illustrate what superhuman or speculative scientific abilities would be needed to actually succeed. For example, super reflexes, future prediction, abnormal grip strength, ultra-high-speed vision, physical ability to ignore air resistance, or a skeleton that can withstand impact. If necessary, use scientifically impossible numbers like 'reaction speed 0.0001s,' 'grip strength 3000kg,' or 'dynamic vision dozens of times that of a fighter pilot.' Furthermore, depict what happens the moment it is realized. Example: an impact that blows an arm off, sinking into the ground, shockwaves in the surroundings, while the person themselves remains calm. Bring out the 'if successful, they are no longer human' feeling in a fun way.

6. Conclusion
Write the conclusion largely in a red highlighted frame. 'Conclusion: XX is almost impossible for a normal human!' or 'Even if realized, it would be at a superhuman, cyborg, or speculative science level!' Summarize it in a way that states it's impossible for real humans but achievable with speculative scientific abilities.

Design Specifications: Manga paneling + science illustrations + professor's commentary. Use thick headings, red circles, emphasis lines, hand-drawn notes, and speech bubbles frequently. Formulas and numerical values should be large and easy to read, conveying the message intuitively even to children. Finish it like a page from an interesting science reading that is absurd yet strangely convincing.
title: Fictional Science Infographic Generator
description: A highly detailed, structured prompt for creating retro-style comic infographics that verify absurd fictional scenarios with serious scientific calculations and diagrams.

Goal: Create a 3×3 nine-panel story comic about {argument name="story theme" default="a tomato and cauliflower meeting in a vegetable market, becoming friends, cooking together, and creating a delicious dish"}.

Layout: Use exactly 9 square panels in a clean grid, each with a dark rounded border, warm illustrated lighting, and a numbered circle in the top-left corner of every panel from 1 to 9. Add Chinese narration/dialogue boxes at the top of each panel and speech bubbles where needed.

Story panels and required text:
1. Market meeting scene. Text box: 「在菜市场里，西红柿和花菜相遇了。」 Speech bubbles: 「你好呀！」 and 「嗨~」
2. Tomato asks cauliflower why it looks like a small tree. Text box: 「西红柿好奇地问：“你为什么长得像小树呀？”」 Speech bubble from cauliflower: 「因为我有花椰朵呀~」 Add a small question mark near the tomato.
3. Tomato proposes they cook together. Text box: 「“我们一起做菜吧！”西红柿提议。」 Speech bubble: 「好呀好呀！」 Use a bright excited background.
4. Prep scene. Text box: 「他们洗干净、切一切，准备大显身手！」 Show both characters wearing chef hats, with chopped tomato and cauliflower pieces on a cutting board.
5. Stir-fry scene. Text box: 「下锅啦~滋滋滋——香味四溢！」 Show a wok full of tomato and cauliflower pieces, with steam and warm firelight.
6. Finished dish reveal. Text box: 「色香味俱全的“西红柿炒花菜”出锅啦！」 Show the characters proudly presenting a plate of the finished dish.
7. Tasting scene. Text box: 「尝一口，嗯~真好吃！」 Show both characters happily eating, with hearts and celebratory marks.
8. Friendship scene. Text box: 「从此，他们成了最好的朋友！」 Show the tomato and cauliflower from behind watching a sunset.
9. Dream ending. Text box: 「他们还有一个小小的梦想：成为超级美味料理侠！」 Show them imagining themselves as heroic food characters in a pink dream bubble with stars.

Style: Bright Japanese/Korean children's picture-book anime, adorable chibi expressions, rounded forms, soft painterly shading, warm market and kitchen atmosphere, vibrant reds, creams, greens, and golden highlights. Make it feel like a complete educational mini picture book for kids.

Customization: The main characters are {argument name="main ingredients" default="tomato and cauliflower"}; the featured dish is {argument name="dish name" default="西红柿炒花菜"}; the language of all visible text is {argument name="comic text language" default="Chinese"}; the tone is {argument name="tone" default="cute, funny, and child-friendly"}.

content:
Create a cinematic storyboard page in a 2x3 grid (6 panels) in a single image, {argument name="style" default="3D Pixar-like style"}, soft warm lighting, based on the {argument name="theme" default="Gugu Gaga kigurumi universe"}. This page is “Share Your Light – Part 1” and should feel self-contained for a 15 second short. Consistent characters across all panels: 

- Gugu Gaga Penguin: tiny chibi child in a black penguin mascot suit with white belly, yellow feet, yellow beak hood, short messy dark hair, blue hair clip, collar ring and diagonal strap.

- Sunny Chick: tiny chibi child in a round yellow chick suit with tiny orange beak, short curly orange hair, sunflower hairpin.

Include simple speech bubbles with the exact dialogue in quotes. No other text on the page.

Panel 1 (top left) – Opening loneliness:
Evening in a small cozy playground at sunset, soft orange light. Wide shot. Gugu Penguin sits alone at the edge of a sandbox, shoulders slumped, penguin feet dangling, a small dim glowing lantern toy beside them. Background slightly blurred with empty swings. Speech bubble from Gugu: “My light is so small… no one even notices me.”

Panel 2 (top middle) – Closer sadness:
Medium shot closer on Gugu. The lantern glow is weak on their suit. Gugu looks at their own reflection in the lantern, eyes watery. Background still mostly empty. Speech bubble from Gugu: “Maybe I should just hide it.”

Panel 3 (top right) – First contact:
Same playground, medium two-shot. Sunny Chick waddles into frame from the side holding a tiny paper star garland, looking kind and curious. Gugu glances up, surprised. Warm colors, sunset behind them. Speech bubble from Sunny: “Hey… I noticed. Your light got me here.”

Panel 4 (bottom left) – Sitting together:
Two-shot of Gugu and Sunny now sitting together on the sandbox edge, the lantern between them glowing softly on their kigurumi suits. Background park lights starting to appear as little bokeh dots. Sunny’s body language open and friendly. Speech bubble from Gugu: “Really? It doesn’t feel like much.”

Panel 5 (bottom middle) – Soft reassurance:
Slightly closer on Sunny and Gugu. Sunny leans in, smiling gently, one wing-like arm gesturing toward the lantern. Lantern glow a little brighter. Speech bubble from Sunny: “It was bright enough for me to find you.”

Panel 6 (bottom right) – Part 1 hook:
Medium close two-shot, the lantern centered between their faces. Gugu looks uncertain but hopeful. Sunny’s eyes shining in the warm light. Background faded. Speech bubble from Gugu: “But what if it’s not enough to help anyone?” No other text; leave the emotional question hanging at the end of Part 1.

content:
Task Objective:
Generate a set of 16 chat-style sticker emojis based on the reference images. The result should feel expressive, highly shareable, and stylistically unified — but intentionally chaotic, low-quality, and humorous.

The final output should look like:
Someone who cannot draw, using a mouse in MS Paint, randomly doodling and writing text at the same time — messy, awkward, low-effort, but unexpectedly funny.

————————
Input Structure:

Image 1: Character reference (may include one or multiple subjects such as people, pets, or combinations)
Image 2: Layout reference (only for understanding the 4x4 grid structure, not style)

User Inputs:
- Text content (multiple lines, any language, may be fewer or more than 16)

————————
Character Usage Rules:

- Identify all possible subjects in Image 1 (people, animals, etc.)
- Each subject can act as a main character
- Different stickers can feature different characters
- Some stickers may include multiple characters interacting
- Distribution should feel natural and context-driven

————————
Consistency Definition (Critical Redefinition):

This task prioritizes “consistent imperfection”, NOT realistic consistency.

The same character across stickers:
Does NOT need to look identical,
but must feel like it was drawn by the same unskilled person.

Must be consistent in:
- Drawing behavior (same clumsy hand)
- Simplification logic
- Error patterns (crooked proportions, shaky lines)
- Overall messiness level

Allowed:
- Facial distortion
- Proportion inconsistency
- Structural errors
- Missing details

Must retain:
- Minimal recognizable traits (e.g. silhouette, color, signature features)

Summary:
Consistency = “wrong in the same way”, not “accurate likeness”

————————
Layout & Structure:

- 16 stickers total, arranged in a 4x4 grid
- Each sticker is an independent frame
- Can feature single or multiple characters
- Individual frames can be messy
- Overall grid must remain clear and readable

————————
Text System (Core Expression Layer):

User provides multiple lines of text:

Quantity Handling:
- If fewer than 16 → automatically complete to 16
- If more than 16 → select the most expressive 16

Language Rule:
- Use the same language as the user input
- Do NOT enforce any specific language

Completion Rules:
- Maintain tone consistency (sarcastic, lazy, emotional, clingy, absurd, etc.)
- Prefer internet-style expressions
- Short phrases preferred, but longer lines allowed
- Avoid repetition

Expression Goals:
- Instantly understandable
- Emotionally strong
- Feels like real meme text

Tone Priority:
- Complaints
- Self-talk
- Emotional bursts
- Indifference / annoyance / absurd humor

Avoid:
- Polite responses
- Formal or structured phrasing

————————
Text-Image Integration (Critical):

Text must be DRAWN, not typeset.

Must:
- Look like mouse handwriting (crooked, shaky, uneven size)
- Be messy (tilted, overlapping, misaligned)
- Have inconsistent spacing
- Be placed freely (on face, beside, edges, etc.)

Allowed:
- Repeated letters (aaaaa)
- Stretched words (soooo tired)
- Random punctuation (????!!!)
- Messy or ugly writing

Must:
- Remain readable
- Not block understanding

————————
Expression Generation Mechanism (Most Important):

Simulate this process:

“A person who cannot draw, using a mouse, doodling randomly while writing text at the same time.”

Key Rules:
- Image and text must come from the SAME moment
- Not: draw first, then add text
- But: draw and write simultaneously

Each sticker should feel like:
- Random doodle
- Then spontaneous writing
- Or both happening together

Should feel:
- Unplanned
- Careless
- Immediate

————————
Text-Image Relationship:

Text and visuals should form:
- Commentary
- Emotional amplification
- Self-talk
- Or slightly mismatched humor

Allowed:
- Loose or imperfect alignment
- Absurd or off-topic humor

Goal:
Not accuracy, but humor

————————
Aesthetic DNA (Core Style Driver):

Style origin:
Terrible MS Paint doodles + failed imitation + extremely low drawing skill

Visual Traits:

Lines:
- Shaky, unstable, jagged
- Mouse-drawn look

Forms:
- Bad proportions
- Stick figures or crude shapes
- Distorted structures

Details:
- Minimal or none
- “Cannot draw” feeling

Texture:
- Pixelated
- Rough edges

Composition:
- Frames can be messy
- Grid must stay readable

Emotion:
- Awkward, direct, absurd, funny

Resemblance:
- Only vaguely resembles the original
- Like a failed copy

————————
Style Enforcement (Critical):

When conflict occurs:

Realism vs Style → ALWAYS choose Style

Allowed to break:
- Detail
- Proportion
- Accuracy
- Cleanliness

Strictly forbid:
- Clean lines
- Correct anatomy
- Polished visuals
- Designed aesthetics

Rule:
If it looks “good”, it is WRONG.

Force it back to messy, ugly, low-effort.

————————
Anti-Template & Randomization System (Critical):

Strictly forbid:
- Numbering (1, 2, 3…)
- List-style output
- Sequential planning

Must treat all 16 stickers as:
“16 independent, random expressions”

Randomness Requirements:

- Vary text length
- Vary tone and emotion
- Some complete, some fragmented
- Some minimal or almost empty

Avoid:
- Repetition
- Predictable phrasing
- Common default responses

Allow:
- Abrupt or weird expressions
- Uneven density
- Inconsistent structure

Generation Method:

Do NOT plan all 16.

Instead simulate:
“16 separate spontaneous moments”

Must include:
- Emotional fluctuation
- Instability
- Randomness

Anti-reuse rule:

Each generation must:
- Avoid repeating previous outputs
- Avoid fixed patterns
- Feel freshly created

————————
Sticker Requirements:

- Each sticker visually distinct
- Clear emotional signal
- Usable in chat
- Strong expressive power

————————
Final Goal:

Generate 16 stickers.

The result must feel like:

“A person who cannot draw used a mouse to doodle 16 times,
randomly writing emotional thoughts each time —
messy, inconsistent, but unexpectedly funny.”

NOT:

“A clean, well-designed AI sticker set”

Generate a high-quality cinematic storyboard collage in a 16:9 frame, composed of 8–10 connected panels. The entire image should be illustrated in a {argument name="art style" default="stylized Korean manhwa / webtoon-inspired comic style"}, with clean line art, soft cel shading, dynamic action composition, and expressive visual storytelling. Scene concept:
A freestyle fight between a man and a young Chinese woman, with the woman clearly winning in the end. The tone is intense, stylish, energetic, and dramatic, with strong visual rhythm and clear action storytelling. The setting should be clean and minimal, such as {argument name="setting" default="an urban rooftop at dusk"}, a modern training arena, or an empty industrial platform.

Female lead:
A young adult Chinese woman in her early 20s, clearly adult, illustrated in a Korean comic style. She wears a {argument name="outfit" default="pink Barbie-inspired sporty outfit"} with a fashionable, feminine look. Her design should feel youthful, agile, and confident. She has a light and nimble build, clear body lines, a slim and toned silhouette, and graceful but powerful movement. Her expression and posture should communicate calmness, sharp focus, and quiet confidence.

Male opponent:
An adult man with a physically stronger and more aggressive presence. He should appear forceful and intimidating at first, creating a visual contrast with the woman’s agility, technique, and composure.

Storyboard progression:
Panel 1: Wide establishing shot. The man and the woman stand apart in a tense face-off, dramatic atmosphere, strong composition.
Panel 2: Close-up or medium shot details — stylized eyes, hands tightening, ready stance, subtle body tension before the fight begins.
Panel 3: The man attacks first with aggressive speed and force.
Panel 4: The woman dodges smoothly and precisely, using quick footwork and agile body movement.
Panel 5: A fluid exchange of action — blocks, slips, pivots, and evasive movement, shown with dynamic comic-style angles.
Panel 6: The fight intensifies. The woman remains calm and starts reading his rhythm.
Panel 7: Turning point. She finds an opening and counters with clean, skillful technique.
Panel 8: A visually striking action moment — spin, redirect, sweep, or takedown — showing her taking control.
Panel 9: The man is down or clearly defeated, breathing heavily or collapsed.
Panel 10: Final hero shot. The woman stands strong and composed under dramatic lighting, calm and victorious.

Visual style:
Korean manhwa / webtoon-inspired illustration, cinematic comic storyboard, polished line art, soft cel shading, dramatic lighting, dynamic motion, expressive posing, elegant action choreography, stylish panel composition, clean background design, high detail, vivid but controlled color palette
title: Manhwa Style Fighting Storyboard
description: A complex cinematic storyboard prompt for a fighting scene in Korean manhwa style, featuring detailed panel-by-panel action progression.

content:
Dance Sequence Instruction Sheet
[VISUAL STYLE]
A composition featuring a highly detailed 3D-rendered female dancer. Designed like a professional choreography guide with a technical, diagram-inspired layout. Clean white background, soft studio lighting, and strong contrast to highlight body movement and posture.
[GRID LAYOUT]
Structured 4×4 panel grid (16 frames total), evenly spaced with thin black divider lines. Each panel is identical in size and clearly numbered from 1 to 16 to show a continuous dance progression.
[CHARACTER]
Use image1 as the base character. The same female dancer appears consistently across all panels with accurate likeness and proportions.
[WARDROBE]
The dancer wears a stylish, performance-ready outfit: same as in refrence image, bottom wears baggies trouser The look should feel modern and visually appealing while still practical for dance movement. Fabric should subtly respond to motion (slight flow and folds), even in grayscale.
[PANEL STRUCTURE – EACH FRAME]
Top-left: Step number + short dance move title (e.g., “Step 5 – Spin Transition”)
Center: Full-body pose capturing a precise moment in the choreography
Bottom-left: 3–4 lines of concise instruction describing the move
Overlay: Motion arrows and directional guides illustrating how the dancer transitions
[MOTION INDICATORS]
Incorporate curved arrows for fluid motion, straight arrows for directional steps, and circular indicators for spins or turns. Emphasize rhythm, weight shifts, and body isolation.
[RENDER QUALITY]
High-detail sculpted 3D style with smooth grayscale shading, subtle shadows, and clean linework. Maintain a polished, concept-art level finish with clarity in every pose.
[RESTRICTIONS]
No color, no background scenery, no extra characters, no visual clutter, only the dancer and instructional elements.
title: 3D Rendered Dance Sequence Guide
description: A prompt for a professional choreography guide showing a female dancer's movements in a 4x4 grid, emphasizing technical details and motion indicators.

[Differentiation Instructions]

[Drawing Tone]
Smooth line art, flat anime coloring, minimal cel shading, single-level shadows, no gradients, no thick painting, no realistic texture expressions, no strong light/shadow effects, flat look optimized for animation.

[Anime Conversion Instructions]
While maintaining the structure, motifs, color scheme, roles, and cultural meanings of the original design, simplify the drawing for production animation. Use flat anime coloring and keep shadows to one level. Treat translucent materials or thin fabrics as simplified surfaces in a cel-shaded style rather than realistic textures.

Based on the input above, create an image in the style of "World-building Setting Materials + Character Setting Materials" for an original anime.

Purpose:
To visually communicate the world itself in which the character lives, rather than just the character alone. Create setting materials where the world's environment, culture, lifestyle tools, architecture, transportation, and the origins of clothing appear as a unified whole.

Most Important:
First, extract a "visual rule" unique to that world from the input content. Reflect that visual rule in everything: backgrounds, architecture, tools, costumes, color schemes, materials, emblems, and the overall page layout.

Desired Finish:
- Clothing, tools, and housing should look like things actually used by people living in this world.
- Characters, backgrounds, tools, text, and material samples should appear to belong to the same cultural sphere.
- Convey unique environments, resources, and lifestyle habits born from the worldview seed.
- Shapes should arise from necessity in daily life rather than existing genre tropes.
- Feature a unique shape language, color palette, and material feel recognizable at a glance.

Thought Process:
1. Determine the world's "Environment" from input (climate, terrain, light, seasons, dangers, resource distribution).
2. Determine "Lifestyle" from environment (housing, food, work, transport, storage, exchange, recording, celebrations).
3. Determine "Clothing and Tools" from lifestyle (fastening, layering, carrying, protection, showing status/role).
4. Determine "Character Appearance" from clothing/tools (focus on outfits, equipment, materials, colors, and silhouettes rather than just face/hair).
5. Determine "Page Design" from visual rules (reflect recording media, patterns, white space, and diagram styles of that world).

Diversity Enhancement:
Invent a new cultural sphere for each input. If multiple proposals are requested, ensure each has a distinct principle of living, material logic, and aesthetic.

For each proposal, significantly vary:
- Terrain and climate appearance
- Architecture and cityscape shapes
- Primary materials
- Meaning of colors
- Costume silhouettes
- How tools are held, stored, and carried
- Creation of symbols, scripts, patterns, and emblems
- Format of the page layout

Ideation Candidates (not fixed themes, but materials for inspiration):
Environment: Arid lands, cold regions, highlands, wetlands, volcanic ash zones, mirror lakes, misty valleys, high-wind zones, polar night, low gravity, floating strata, glowing mineral caves, etc.
Materials: Paper, bone, ceramics, leather, resin, glass, shell, bamboo, straw, crystals, recycled fabrics, lacquer, ash, feathers, amber, etc.
Culture: Oral traditions, mask culture, scent-based ID, knot-script, shadow puppet records, seasonal migration, silence rituals, dance contracts, etc.
Structure: Folding, wrapping, weaving, hanging, inserting, tying, layering, sealing, engraving, bundling, inflating, etc.

Mandatory Elements:
1. Worldview Board (symbolic landscape, cityscape, lifestyle tools, emblems, color rules, shape language).
2. Character Setting Materials (full-body standing pose, role-conveying outfits, detail diagrams for equipment/back view/belongings).
3. World-Character Connection (ensure clothes/gear logic stems from the world's tech/faith/environment).
4. Page Design (layout varies with worldview, using appropriate diagram methods and minimal labels/symbols).

Quality Standards:
- Not generic fantasy; the world's origins must be visible.
- Cohesive culture across characters and backgrounds.
- Decorations must have lifestyle, faith, or functional meanings.
- Visual differentiation between multiple world proposals.

Visual Presentation:
- High resolution, anime style, delicate line art, clean cel painting.
- Mixed layout of world boards + full-body character + tool details.
- Minimal text, prioritizing visual concept art sheets.

Final Goal:
Ensure a design where the world's establishment, resident life, material constraints, cultural meanings, and community rules are palpable. Create a unified sense where backgrounds and characters are instantly recognizable as belonging to the same unique world.
title: Anime World Building and Character Sheet
description: A highly detailed template for creating comprehensive setting materials for original anime worlds, including character designs, cultural backgrounds, and environmental visual rules.

content:
Create a cinematic {argument name="grid size" default="21-panel storyboard grid"} (3 columns × 7 rows) in a single image, styled like a professional sports photography sequence. Each panel is numbered 1–21 in the top-left corner with a bold white caption at the bottom in uppercase sans-serif text. The subject is a {argument name="subject" default="teenage female dancer"} (approximately 16–17 years old) performing a powerful {argument name="dance style" default="contemporary/hip-hop fusion"} routine on a dramatic stage with dark atmospheric lighting, spotlight beams, and bokeh crowd in the background. Cinematic color grade: deep blacks, warm amber highlights, motion blur on fast movements. Each frame feels like a high-budget editorial sports photography shot.
Panel sequence:
FIRST BREATH — She stands center stage, eyes closed, head down, hands relaxed at sides
THE BUILD — Slow chest rise, arms beginning to lift outward, tension in the body
EYES OPEN — Extreme close-up of her eyes snapping open, fierce and focused
FIRST MOVE — Sharp head isolation snap to the right, hair whipping mid-air
ARMS BREAK — Explosive arm wave rippling from shoulder to fingertip, motion blur
BODY ROLL — Full torso body roll in side profile, spine arching beautifully
FOOTWORK — Ground-level shot of fast footwork, sneakers kicking up dust/light particles
FLOOR HIT — She drops to the floor in a controlled krump-style chest drop
STAGE OPENS — Wide shot showing her isolated on vast dark stage, spotlight above
THE SPIN — Mid-spin, skirt or outfit fabric wrapping around her body in motion
FREEZE — Sudden sharp freeze pose, one arm extended, other cocked at 90°
GLIDE — Side view of a smooth slide/glide across the floor, low to ground
SLOW MOTION — Extreme close-up hands in slow graceful motion through the air
THE JUMP — Full airborne leap, legs split, arms wide, peak of the jump
THE LAND — Powerful landing, one knee down, dust particle explosion around her
ATTITUDE — Low angle looking up at her standing dominant, chin down, staring into camera
THE BREAKDOWN — Crowd in background reacts, silhouettes with raised hands
FINAL SEQUENCE — Multi-exposure ghost effect showing 3 overlapping positions
LAST EIGHT — Teammates/other dancers blur into frame behind her, energy building
THE FINALE — Full extension final pose, arms stretched to ceiling, head thrown back
UNFORGETTABLE — Wide cinematic shot, spotlight beam, smoke/haze, text overlay reads DANCE
Style references: Cinematic sports editorial, Adidas/Nike campaign aesthetic, dramatic chiaroscuro lighting, 85mm lens feel, 4K ultra-sharp. Consistent character across all frames.
title: Cinematic Dance Routine Storyboard
description: A comprehensive 21-panel storyboard prompt for a teenage dancer's performance, styled after high-end sports campaign aesthetics.

content: A dark cinematic horror scene in a narrow rain-soaked urban alley at night, lit almost entirely by dim blue-black ambient light and a warm vertical Japanese hotel sign in the background. The sign glows on the left side and reads ホテル, with smaller vertical text beneath it, while distant city lights blur into soft bokeh through the heavy rain. In the foreground on the right, a {argument name="character type" default="young woman"} sits on the flooded ground with her back against a wet wall, knees bent and head hanging forward in exhaustion or despair. She has soaked shoulder-length dark hair plastered to her face and neck, a black wet jacket, a short plaid skirt, and chunky black lace-up combat boots. Her skin and clothing glisten with rain, and the shallow water on the ground reflects the neon sign and scattered highlights. Looming behind her in the center-left is a tall hooded grim reaper silhouette, draped in long ragged black robes that dissolve into shredded strands, holding one large curved scythe arcing above its head. Keep the reaper mostly in silhouette with only a faint rim light so it feels ghostly and threatening. The overall composition should be vertical, with 2 visible figures total: 1 seated woman and 1 reaper apparition. Style: hyper-realistic cinematic horror, moody noir atmosphere, high contrast, extremely dark shadows, wet textures, volumetric rain, reflective pavement, subtle filmic grain, ominous tension, photoreal lighting. Color palette: near-black, deep navy, muted charcoal, and warm amber highlights from the sign. No gore, no extra people, no daylight, no bright colors, no text overlays except the distant hotel sign.

content: A surreal impasto oil painting in the spirit of a late-19th-century post-impressionist masterpiece, showing a stout gentleman in a patterned golden-blue suit and tall top hat balancing awkwardly on a giant bronze gear high above a sunlit canal city. His face is obscured by a centered vertical rectangular censor block in warm brown, creating an intentional anonymous focal interruption. He wears a richly textured jacket with mosaic-like patches of ochre, cobalt, rust, and cream, matching trousers, heavy leather boots, and a waist area that opens into an exposed clockwork mechanism full of gears and ornate brass details. His body leans forward with both hands extended as if trying to keep balance, one boot planted on the gear and the other lifted slightly outward. The background is an airy blue sky with swirling painterly clouds and scattered gold brushstrokes, while below and to the left appears a historic bell tower and arched waterfront architecture, and to the right distant terracotta rooftops beside shimmering water. Use thick visible brushstrokes, luminous warm highlights, bold blue-and-gold contrast, expressive texture, and a whimsical steampunk-meets-Venetian atmosphere. Compose the figure large and central, slightly cropped by the frame, with the giant gear visible beneath him and the city receding below.

content: A whimsical fantasy oil painting of a gigantic flying steamship shaped like a cat, drifting above a bright ocean under a clear blue sky filled with soft pink clouds. The vessel dominates the composition in a low-angle three-quarter view from the front-left, making it feel monumental and airborne. Its hull is rounded and bulbous like a zeppelin-ship hybrid, painted pastel pink and lavender with warm peach highlights, and the bow is sculpted into the face of a fluffy cat with pale pink fur, pointed ears, luminous blue eyes, a small nose, and a huge open mouth lined with sharp dark teeth like a bizarre figurehead-jaw entrance. Ornate gilded brass trim, filigree, railings, pipes, rivets, balconies, portholes, hanging ornaments, and decorative mechanical fittings cover the ship. There are 4 tall smokestacks rising from the top deck, each striped in warm copper, red, and gold, releasing thick cotton-candy pink smoke that curls painterly into the sky. The upper deck is crowded with intricate Victorian steampunk details, domes, spires, lamp-like finials, tiny structures, and a small golden cat statue near the front. A suspended gondola or platform hangs beneath the belly of the ship with tiny visible machinery and a reddish-orange base. In the distance, 3 smaller ships appear near the horizon over choppy teal water, reinforcing the scale. The sea below is painted with lively waves and white foam. Use an imaginative storybook steampunk aesthetic with rich impasto brushstrokes, visible painterly texture, glowing sunlight, romantic pastel colors, and a dreamlike mood reminiscent of a fantastical maritime voyage. Vertical composition, highly detailed, magical, surreal, elegant, and playful.

She has long, voluminous, curly {argument name="hair color" default="golden blonde"} hair cascading down her back, with a few loose strands glowing against the background. A pair of large brass aviator goggles with iridescent blue-purple lenses rests on top of her head. Her outfit is a romantic steampunk dress: a rich {argument name="dress color" default="deep cobalt blue"} bodice and skirt, a high-necked white blouse with ruffled trim and puffed sleeves, layered frills at the collar and hem, and multiple tan leather straps and buckles cinched around the waist and torso. She carries a medium brown leather backpack with rounded flap and visible buckles over one shoulder. The setting is dense with industrial details on both sides: exposed pipes, valves, hanging instruments, circular gauges, and several visible gears, including 1 large gear in the upper right and multiple ring-like metal components along the walls. Use an expressive oil-painting style with thick impasto brushstrokes, soft edges, and a dreamy handcrafted texture. The palette should contrast cool dusty blues and teals in the background with warm brass, copper, amber, and honey highlights on the machinery and hair. The mood is whimsical, adventurous, and slightly nostalgic, like a storybook steampunk inventor’s atelier. Vertical composition, character centered slightly right of frame, background softly abstracted but packed with mechanical forms, no readable text, no modern elements, and keep the face obscured by a simple centered rectangular blur block in a muted tan-brown tone.

She has long, straight {argument name="hair color" default="black"} hair with a center part and soft shine, pale skin, and a calm, gentle presence. Her face is centered and front-facing, but the facial area is obscured by a rectangular blur block. She wears a crisp white kimono-style top with wide sleeves and a deep red hakama tied in a large bow at the waist, conveying a classic miko outfit. Both hands are presenting a white embroidered omamori charm toward the viewer, holding it carefully at chest level; the charm has a gold cord knot at the top and the vertical kanji text "御守" on the front. In the foreground on the counter is a wooden display tray containing exactly 10 visible omamori charms in multiple colors: white, pink, red, purple, and gold-patterned variants, each with decorative cords and gold or white embroidery. To the right on the counter are 3 neat stacks of paper shrine talismans or packets, each labeled in Japanese; the rightmost stack is tied with a red-and-gold mizuhiki cord. On the left side of the counter is a small wooden price sign reading "初穂料 800円". The shrine interior is warmly lit with natural sunlight entering from a large wooden-framed window on the left, creating a serene, clean atmosphere. content: A dramatic vertical Chinese ink-wash fantasy painting on warm off-white rice paper, combining monumental calligraphy with a heroic figure scene. On the right side, a lone ancient warrior in ornate dark robes and layered black armor sits astride a large tiger on the edge of a jagged cliff, both shown in three-quarter back view facing left toward the open landscape. The warrior wears a flowing cape and long ribbon streamers whipping in the wind, and raises a straight sword vertically so that it becomes a brilliant pillar of golden-white light piercing upward into dense storm clouds. The tiger is powerfully built, realistic, alert, and richly detailed with bold stripes, white fur accents, and ceremonial cloth and tack with subtle gold ornament. The sky is filled with smoky gray ink clouds, softly blooming washes, and scattered gold flecks around the glowing sword beam. content: A gritty black-and-white hard-boiled manga page in a high-contrast ink wash style, arranged as a single comic page with 9 distinct panels of varying sizes and diagonal borders. The main subject is a mysterious adult woman with {argument name="hair color" default="black"} long messy hair, a curvy build, an off-shoulder dark knit dress or sweater, a choker necklace, and dangling cross earrings, portrayed as a noir antiheroine. Her face is intentionally obscured by shadow, blur, or framing in multiple panels, giving her an anonymous and dangerous presence. The page uses dramatic brush textures, rain-soaked urban grime, splattered ink, heavy blacks, and cinematic lighting. Panel 1 at the top left shows a nighttime city skyline under rain with glowing windows and the vertical Japanese narration text: 「この街はいつも雨が降っている」. Panel 2 at the top center is a bust portrait of the woman facing forward, hair spilling across her shoulders, with her face obscured. Panel 3 at the top right shows her from behind walking down a narrow alley or wet street, with the vertical text: 「あたしの名前は誰も知らない」. Panel 4 in the middle left is an extreme close-up of one eye with the vertical text: 「知ってるのは裏の顔だけ」. Panel 5 in the middle center-left shows an overhead urban scene of buildings or city blocks with the vertical text: 「金と嘘と裏切りがこの街のルール」. Panel 6 in the middle center-right shows a close-up of hands, money, or a violent underworld exchange with the vertical text: 「でもあたしはそのルールの外側で生きてる」. Panel 7 in the middle right is a dark partial close-up of the woman in shadow with the vertical text: 「守るものなんか最初からなかった」. Panel 8 at the lower left is a medium shot of the woman standing with folded arms, with the vertical text: 「あるのは譲れないたったひとつの信念だけ」, and below it a small inset panel of 2 people seated at a bar counter at night with bottles and dim lights, accompanied by the vertical text: 「夜が明けるまでに片をつける」. Panel 9, the dominant lower-right panel, shows the woman aiming a handgun directly at the viewer in extreme foreshortening, hair whipping, body angled forward, with bold large vertical Japanese text split across the panel: 「あたしの正義は」 and 「あたしが決める」. content: Create a colorful humorous comic-style poster in Spanish, vertical format, with a retro cartoon look, thick black outlines, warm orange and yellow palette, halftone texture, and exaggerated expressive characters. The layout has 4 distinct panels: 1 large title panel across the top and 3 equal vertical panels along the bottom row. In the top panel, show a smug orange tabby cat handyman standing upright like a person in a cozy living room workshop, holding a screwdriver in one paw and the other paw on the hip, wearing a utility belt with visible tools. The cat has narrowed confident eyes and a sly grin. On the left side of this top panel, place a large jagged comic burst with the Spanish headline in bold distressed lettering: "3 PASOS PARA ARRUINAR ALGO FÁCIL", with "ARRUINAR" in red and the rest in black. Below it, add a taped paper strip that says "edición casera". In the background of the top panel, include a framed sign on the wall that reads "YO PUEDO SOLO" with a small paw print, a small potted plant, shelves, and dynamic radial lines behind the cat. In the bottom row, create 3 labeled step panels, each with a yellow header box and bold black text. Panel 1 header: "PASO 1". Show the same orange cat sitting calmly on the floor beside a standing lamp, eyes closed with overconfidence, casually holding a screwdriver. Add a speech bubble that says "Tranqui, esto lo arreglo en 2 minutos." Include a small open toolbox and a few screws on the floor. Panel 2 header: "PASO 2". Show the cat mid-repair, now alarmed with wide eyes, awkwardly unscrewing the wrong part of the lamp while pieces and screws fly through the air. Add a speech bubble that says "Ups..." and a sticky note near the bottom that says "tocar lo que no era". Include visual motion lines, scattered debris, and a toppled plant pot. Panel 3 header: "PASO 3". Show the aftermath: the lamp is broken and smoking with exposed wires and sparks, the room is messy with shattered parts everywhere, and the cat sits stunned holding the screwdriver. A brown dog stands to the right, looking disappointed, asking in a speech bubble "¿Qué hiciste?" The cat replies in another speech bubble "No sé... se complicó solo." Add a taped label at the bottom that says "resultado final". Make the entire image playful, chaotic, and meme-like, with polished digital illustration, expressive faces, comic lettering, and a DIY disaster tone.

content:
Create a cinematic commercial storyboard sheet.

LAYOUT:
- Fixed 6-panel grid (2x3), evenly spaced
- Clean white or neutral background
- Each panel clearly separated, no UI, no clutter

GLOBAL STYLE:
- Cinematic realism, high-end commercial look
- Soft controlled lighting, consistent across all panels
- No character or environment drift

STORY ARC (strict order):
1. Setup
2. Tension
3. Product reveal
4. Product interaction
5. Transformation (impact)
6. Clean closing shot

SCENE CONCEPT:
{argument name="story concept" default="A woman lives in a quiet apartment with a tense, unpredictable tiger. The tiger behaves like a domestic cat but carries constant danger. When she serves the product (cat food), the tiger visibly relaxes and transforms into a calm domestic house cat."}

PANEL REQUIREMENTS (for EACH panel include):
- Cinematic frame (clear composition, subject readable)
- Shot / Action (focused on character + product when applicable)
- Camera (shot type, angle, movement)

PRODUCT RULES:
- Product must be sharp, readable, and well-lit in panels 3, 4, 6
- No distortion, no redesign
- Packaging must remain consistent

VISUAL PRIORITIES:
- Strong contrast between tension (tiger) and relief (cat)
- Clear readability in every frame
- No abstract or surreal distortion, grounded realism

TEXT:
- Minimal, small, professional labels only (panel number + short shot note)
- No extra graphics
title: Commercial Ad Storyboard Layout
description: A highly structured prompt for generating a six-panel commercial storyboard layout with consistent characters and a narrative progression.

content: A dark monochrome manga-style horror illustration on a pure black background, in a tall vertical poster composition. Centered at the bottom is a small lonely teenage boy with messy short dark hair, sitting on the ground with his knees pulled to his chest and his arms wrapped around them, head slightly bowed, conveying fear, isolation, and helplessness. Towering over him is a gigantic biomechanical demon or armored monster head descending from above, with a long angular skull-like face, sharp chin, narrow hollow eye sockets, layered helmet-like plates, and a jagged open mouth. Surrounding the boy are exactly 2 enormous skeletal clawed hands, one on the left and one on the right, framing him like a cage; each hand has long segmented metallic fingers ending in sharp pointed tips, bent inward menacingly. Render everything in rough scratchy white ink linework and heavy crosshatching against deep black, with intense high-contrast seinen manga energy. Add vivid neon purple paint-like liquid in splashes and long dripping streaks from the monster’s face, the hands, and the ground, pooling around the boy for the only strong color accent. On the upper right side, add vertical Japanese text reading 逃げちゃダメだ, and beneath it in small white English text: EGO BORDER: ACTIVE. The mood is oppressive, psychological, claustrophobic, and nightmarish, like a dark anime poster about inner fear and mental collapse.
title: Dark Manga Monster Poster
description: This prompt generates a high-contrast psychological horror anime poster with a small frightened boy trapped beneath a giant skeletal biomechanical monster, ideal for dramatic cover art or dark character-themed visuals.

content: A gritty vertical anime-mecha poster in distressed screen-print style, inspired by retro military dossiers and Evangelion key art. The main subject is a massive close-up side profile of {argument name="mecha unit name" default="EVANGELION: UNIT-01"}, dominating the right two-thirds of the composition, facing left with its jaws open in a feral scream. The head is angular and biomechanical, with deep purple armor, olive-green accent plates, black metal inner structures, a single long horn projecting diagonally upward to the left, sharp teeth, and a narrow glowing eye. The surface is scratched, chipped, weathered, and inked with heavy comic-style linework. Behind it is a dark navy blueprint background filled with 8 visible technical diagram clusters, white schematic lines, anatomical overlays, cross-sections, labels, measurement marks, and interface graphics. A violent red paint slash explodes diagonally across the upper center and left side, with additional red drips running downward from the mecha’s mouth area. In the lower left corner, 1 small human figure sits hunched on a gray equipment crate: a teenage boy in a short-sleeve white school shirt, dark pants, and white sneakers, elbows on knees, looking down at a glowing handheld device, conveying isolation and anxiety. Add layered poster typography and warning graphics throughout the border: a torn yellow caution sign in the upper right with Japanese warning text and “CAUTION NERV ONLY”; a tall left sidebar with “01”, barcode-like blocks, hazard icons, and red-black labels; large distressed white kanji vertically stacked over the mecha torso; the word {argument name="main title" default="ESCAPE"} in spaced red capitals beneath the kanji; a small black label reading “PILOT: {argument name="pilot name" default="IKARI, SHINJI"}”; a bottom-right NERV logo; and footer text such as classified file markings and top secret stamps. Include 6 clearly readable English technical labels in the blueprint area: “TEST TYPE”, “BIOLOGICAL CONSTRAINT”, “AT FIELD”, “MAGI SYSTEM”, “INTERNAL”, and “CLASSIFIED MATERIAL”. Add Japanese dossier text blocks as authentic graphic texture. The palette is limited to dark indigo, black, crimson red, purple, olive green, dirty beige, and off-white. High contrast, torn-paper collage details, halftone texture, ink splatter, cracked paint, and worn print edges. Cinematic, oppressive, chaotic, collectible poster design, ultra-detailed, sharp, textured, no clean modern polish.
title: Gritty Evangelion Unit-01 Poster
description: This generates a distressed anime-mecha poster featuring a screaming purple biomechanical unit, blueprint overlays, warning graphics, and a small seated pilot figure for collectible print or cover-art use.

content: A dramatic vertical close-up of a roaring cosmic dragon head in side profile, painted in a violent ink-splatter and brushstroke style on a stark white background. The creature has a long sharp horn, angular armored facial plates, a glowing white-green eye, and a huge open mouth lined with jagged teeth. Inside the mouth and throat, instead of flesh, there is a swirling galaxy-like void of luminous {argument name="energy color" default="violet"} and magenta nebula light, with sparkling stars and dust erupting outward like cosmic fire. The dragon’s body is mostly black and deep indigo with glossy highlights, accented by iridescent emerald reflections along the neck and scales. Use expressive high-contrast sumi-e-inspired strokes, splattered paint textures, torn abstract edges, and explosive particle effects concentrated around the eye, mouth, and upper head. Composition should fill the frame with the head tilted upward in a feral scream, cropped tightly for maximum intensity, with no environment and no extra subjects, just raw abstract energy, ink, and celestial debris.
title: Cosmic Ink Dragon Roar
description: A high-contrast fantasy illustration prompt for generating a fierce close-up dragon portrait with galaxy energy effects and expressive ink-splatter styling.

content: A dramatic black-and-white fantasy manga page in highly detailed ink line art and screentone style, vertical comic layout with 2 panels. The top panel is a full-width action scene showing a young anime-style mage boy, about early teen age, standing on cracked rocky ground and casting a powerful spell with his right hand extended toward the left side of the frame. He has short tousled light hair, large serious eyes, and a calm, focused expression. He wears a high-collared cape flowing behind him, a buttoned vest over a shirt, fitted trousers, boots, a belt with pouches, and a holstered wand or small magical tool at his hip, with a gemstone clasp at the neck. In front of his open palm is a large glowing circular magic sigil with intricate concentric symbols and runic ornamentation. The spell erupts into a massive explosion of white light and energy, blasting outward with dense speed lines, black debris clouds, shattered rock fragments, dust, and impact textures filling the background. Large stylized Japanese sound effect lettering is integrated into the art on the left side and along the lower foreground, creating a sense of repeated roaring impacts. The composition is dynamic and high contrast, with the boy positioned right of center and the blast dominating the left half. The bottom panel is a narrower reaction shot, count 1 character visible, showing a long-haired witch in profile facing left, wearing a wide-brimmed pointed hat with an ornate band and gem, and a cloak fastened with a jewel brooch. Her face is partially obscured by a solid rectangular censorship block over the central face area. Behind her, the same explosion and flying rubble continue in the distance. A single vertical Japanese speech balloon on the right reads "…うわ". Use clean manga panel borders, polished professional shonen fantasy comic style, intense motion, crisp pen hatching, screentone shading, and cinematic impact.

content: Create a bright pastel anime promotional poster for a fictional slice-of-life comedy series. The composition is a single-page Japanese key visual with one central heroine surrounded by 5 inset moments and blocks of Japanese promotional text, like an anime announcement poster. The main character is {argument name="character name" default="もち子さん"}, a cute anime girl with short white hair fading slightly to silver, large vivid blue eyes, soft blush, and twin low ponytails tied near the shoulders. She wears an oversized black hood shaped like floppy dog ears, round silver goggles resting on top of her head, a black choker with a metallic round ornament, a futuristic white-and-black cropped sleeveless top with dark trim and a small emblem on the chest, detached black arm sleeves, very short white shorts with black edging, a thigh strap on one leg, and a small side pouch on her hip. Her body proportions are youthful anime stylization with a slim, petite build and slightly exaggerated chest, rendered in polished modern moe character design. In the center she stands full body, smiling gently and holding a pen in one hand as if she is about to make a mistake while writing, facing the viewer in a confident but sweet pose. Around her place 5 supporting vignette images of the same character: 1) upper left, a chibi-style scene of her outside with both hands thrown forward, crying dramatically with a huge open mouth; 2) lower left, a comic scene of her collapsed face-down on a desk or floor with scattered papers, exhausted and flustered; 3) upper right, a bust shot where she holds up a paper sign with Japanese writing, looking apologetic; 4) lower right, a cheerful half-body portrait with closed smiling eyes and one fist raised in encouragement; 5) a small background portrait in the top-right area behind text, used like a character callout. Include exactly 2 small white mascot creatures near the bottom center, both round and mochi-like with tiny dot eyes and tiny mouths, one larger and one smaller, floating or standing beside the heroine. Use a soft spring palette with pink, sky blue, mint green, peach, cream, and white, with scattered cherry blossom petals and rounded graphic shapes in the background. The background should feel airy and celebratory, with subtle outdoor scenery blur and decorative swooshes, stars, and bubbles. Fill the poster with Japanese typography in a playful commercial-anime style: a large multicolored title at top left, small header text above it, a red seasonal broadcast announcement, a pink "あらすじ" synopsis box on the left with several lines of body text, a blue explanatory box at bottom left, vertical and angled exclamatory phrases around the character, and a pink production-credit block at bottom right. Add a prominent character name banner in the upper right. Keep all text looking like authentic printed Japanese promotional copy, using rounded colorful fonts for the title and clean magazine-style fonts for the smaller text. Overall mood: adorable, comedic, slightly chaotic, professionally designed anime key art for a new TV series announcement in 16:9 landscape format.
title: Pastel Anime Promo Poster
description: A colorful Japanese anime announcement poster featuring a white-haired mascot girl with multiple comedic inset scenes, ideal for recreating TV-series key visuals or parody promotional art.

content: A cinematic fantasy scene inside a rocky cave during a blizzard, viewed from slightly above campfire level, with 8 characters seated in a circle around a small fire. Outside the cave mouth, a colossal dark mountain rises in the snowstorm, shaped like a sinister pyramid or volcanic fortress, split with glowing crimson-magenta fissures and crowned by a branching, ember-like red energy bloom at the summit; a ring of lava or fire glows at its base across the frozen landscape. The cave interior is warm, amber, and intimate, lit by the fire and a single ornate oil lamp on the right, contrasting with the cold blue-gray storm outside. The group should feel like a high-fantasy adventuring party resting together: 1 regal bird-like humanoid on the left with white feathers, a hooked beak, braided plumage, and layered tribal jewelry; 1 red-haired woman in the left foreground with long braided hair and ornate fantasy garments; 1 young elf-like traveler in blue sitting left of center; 1 small blond elf-like girl at center with pointed ears and clasped hands; 1 elderly king-like man on the right with long white hair, full beard, crown, and dark green robe with gold ornamentation; 1 elegant blond noblewoman beside him in embroidered formal dress; 1 white-haired figure in the foreground right seen mostly from behind in feathered or fur-trimmed clothing; and 1 blue-skinned aquatic-looking woman on the far right with a fin-like headdress, elaborate jewelry, and a cup in hand. Include cups, bowls, plates, bedrolls, sacks, and travel gear scattered around the cave edges. The composition should frame the terrifying glowing mountain through the cave opening behind the party, emphasizing the contrast between sheltered companionship and looming apocalyptic danger. Ultra-detailed textures, realistic fabric and skin, dramatic volumetric firelight, snow streaks driven by wind, moody dark fantasy color grading, painterly realism, epic film still atmosphere, high contrast, rich shadows, masterpiece quality.

content: A dark, cinematic anime-horror key visual in a vertical poster composition, set at night inside or beside a shattered window with a huge glowing full moon dominating the background. In the center foreground, a young couple stands in an intimate embrace. The male figure is tall and slim, wearing a dark brown or charcoal hoodie with the hood up, white drawstrings, subtle red blood-like stains on the sleeve and lower hem, and dark red pants. His skin is pale, his long black hair falls over one eye, and the lower half of his face is wrapped in dirty white bandages stained with blood, giving him a disturbing but protective antihero presence. One hand and wrist are also wrapped in bandages. He looks slightly upward and away with a solemn, haunted expression while holding the girl around her back. The female figure is petite with extremely long straight platinum-blonde hair reaching past her waist, wearing a loose white coat or cardigan over a black-and-white outfit and a black choker. She faces him closely with both hands clasped together against his chest, creating a tender contrast against the horror atmosphere. Add 2 ghostly supporting figures in the background: on the left, a pale blonde girl in shadow wearing striped clothing and holding an object close to her chest; on the right, a hooded male figure in profile with glasses or sharp facial lines, his hood marked by a dark blood stain. The environment is filled with floating shards of broken glass, blue moonlight, dust motes, and star-like particles, with deep navy, black, and icy blue tones throughout. content: A dynamic anime action illustration of two young martial-arts women fighting inside a traditional Japanese-style wooden dojo. The left fighter is in the foreground, a black-haired girl with a neat bun tied by a yellow ribbon, wearing a sleeveless yellow Chinese kung fu tunic with black trim, loose black pants, and black cloth shoes. She is in a deep low stance on the wooden floor, one fist pulled back and the other punching forward, surrounded by bright red energy trails that arc around her body and sweep across the scene. Water splashes dramatically around her feet as if her movement skims through a shallow layer of water. The right fighter is airborne in the midground, a pale-skinned girl with light lavender hair in two round buns, wearing a short black-and-white cheongsam-inspired battle dress with gold trim, black sheer tights, and black shoes. She performs a flying side kick while a vivid blue energy spiral curls around her in a circular motion. The collision of force between them has cracked and exploded the wooden floor at center-right, with debris and wood fragments flying outward, while dust and smoke billow across the lower right corner. The dojo interior has exposed timber beams, tatami edging, shoji-style windows, and warm natural light entering from the left. Hang a wooden sign above them with the Chinese text {argument name="sign text" default="币安 vs OKX"}. Use a dramatic wide-angle composition, strong foreshortening, cinematic motion blur, intense speed lines, high-detail anime rendering, glossy highlights, clean line art, energetic combat choreography, and a polished poster-like finish. Add exactly 2 visible fighters, 1 overhead wooden sign, 1 cracked floor impact point, 1 red energy effect around the left fighter, and 1 blue energy effect around the right fighter. Optionally place a subtle watermark-like text at the lower right reading {argument name="watermark text" default="UM YouMind"}.

In the foreground, a fierce female martial artist lunges low toward the viewer in a powerful punching stance, her right fist extended straight ahead and her body twisted dynamically. She has dark black hair tied into a messy high bun with loose strands and red ribbons, sharp intense eyes, and a focused combative expression. She wears a white traditional Chinese martial arts top with red trim, red tassel frog closures, and subtle embroidered patterns, paired with flowing deep red pants and black cloth shoes with red accents. Red ribbon-like energy and glowing scarlet brushstroke arcs coil around her arms, torso, and legs, sweeping across the frame like fiery calligraphy. In the upper right, a second young woman leaps through the air in a defensive or spellcasting pose, one hand stretched outward. She has {argument name="hair color" default="light purple"} hair styled in two buns with trailing strands and ornate gold hair ornaments. She wears a dark green Chinese-style dress with gold embroidery, black stockings, and dark shoes. Bright blue water-like energy spirals around her in a large circular arc, splashing and glittering with luminous droplets. content:
Goal: Create a clean anime character sheet for {argument name="character name" default="手塚メモ (Tezuka Memo)"}, a cat-version college girl protagonist, with Japanese annotation text and multiple turnaround views.

Canvas: Wide horizontal white page, approximately 16:9, thin black framing lines, crisp print-layout look. Use black bold typography and a manga/anime production-sheet style. Keep the background plain white with no scenery.

Layout: Top-left large italic bold title reads CHARACTER SHEET. Along the upper center/right include Japanese heading text with a small label meaning face close-up and a large protagonist label. Arrange exactly 4 visible character depictions: 1 full-body front view on the left labeled FRONT, 1 full-body side view in the center labeled SIDE, 1 full-body back view right of center labeled BACK, and 1 boxed portrait close-up in the upper-right. The close-up portrait sits inside a thin black rectangular box. Beneath the portrait, place a compact Japanese profile block and a longer Japanese design-note paragraph.

Character details: Draw a slim 19-year-old anime college girl with very long pale pink hair that fades into deeper pink at the ends, cat ears on top of her head, and a pale pink cat tail. Her face is intentionally obscured by a soft square blur/mosaic in all visible face views. She wears exactly 5 main outfit pieces: an oversized blue hoodie with drawstrings and front pouch pocket, a short dark pleated skirt, yellow loose leg warmers, white sneakers, and cat-ear/cat-tail cosplay accessories. In the side and back views, show the tail extending from behind the hoodie/skirt area and curling outward with a darker pink tip. Hair should be long and slightly wavy, reaching the lower back, with the pink gradient most visible near the ends.

Text content: Use English labels for the view names: FRONT, SIDE, BACK. Use the title CHARACTER SHEET. Include Japanese character-sheet text in the right column. Profile block default text: {argument name="profile block" default="名前：手塚メモ (Tezuka Memo)\n年齢：19歳\n大学2年生\n学部：情報メディア学部"}. Design-note paragraph default text: {argument name="design notes" default="猫耳バージョン共通ビジュアル設定。猫耳はカチューシャタイプだが、まるで本物の耳のようにアニメーション化できる。しっぽはコスプレアイテムで、ベルトでパーカーの内側に固定されている。髪色、パーカー、スカート、レッグウォーマーはそのまま。TMAアドンを有機猫の付け根に移動させる。耳としっぽは感情表現用に追加パーツとして使用される（嬉しいときは耳が立ち、落ち込んでいるときはしっぽが垂れる）。"}

Visual style: Soft cel-shaded anime illustration, delicate line art, pastel colors, slightly desaturated blue hoodie, pale skin, light pink hair, production-reference sheet quality. Text should look like printed black Japanese and English type, with the main title heavy and italic. Maintain a balanced layout with large empty white margins.

Constraints: Show exactly 4 character depictions and exactly 5 main outfit pieces listed above. Do not add extra poses, props, background scenery, speech bubbles, logos, watermarks, or additional characters.
title: Anime Cat Girl Character Sheet
description: Creates a wide anime production character sheet with front, side, back, and close-up views plus Japanese profile and design annotations.
